text: Every animal adapts to its world. We do the opposite: we adapt the world to us.
Cheetahs have speed. Whales have depth. Physically, humans are outmatched by almost everything in nature.
Yet a million years ago, we did what no creature dared: we mastered fire. Cooking unlocked the energy that supercharged our brains.
Ants build cities through instinct. But humans build civilizations through imagination—shared stories, laws, and ideals.
We are the only animals that contemplate our own existence... and the only ones with the power to protect, or destroy, the world that created us.
